field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this L2 reachability check in the CARP health decision.

field.label: Name
field.help: Unique descriptive name for this health check.

field.label: Probe interface
field.help: Logical OPNsense interface on which the IPv4 ARP health probe is sent.

field.label: IPv4 probe target
field.help: IPv4 address that must answer ARP on the probe interface. The probe uses source 0.0.0.0.

field.label: CARP action scope
field.help: Automatic modes discover CARP VHIDs from the live OPNsense virtual-IP configuration. Probe Interface is the normal per-VLAN mode; All CARP is useful for upstream/WAN health. Explicit VHID modes remain available as an advanced override. Legacy Global uses native global CARP demotion.

field.label: Explicit VHID
field.help: Advanced override used only for Explicit: specific VHID scope. Automatic scopes ignore this field.

field.label: Explicit VHID targets
field.help: Advanced override used only for Explicit: VHID target group. Use comma-separated logical-interface:VHID targets, for example opt2:51,opt3:52. Automatic scopes ignore this field.

field.label: Failure advskew
field.help: advskew enforced while this check is unhealthy. Use 254 for a hard local-segment failure; a lower value can softly move healthy VHIDs after an upstream failure.

field.label: IPv4 fallback host
field.help: Optional IPv4 host route installed while unhealthy and removed on recovery.

field.label: IPv4 fallback gateway
field.help: IPv4 peer next hop for the fallback host route, normally on the dedicated data-plane transit.

field.label: IPv6 fallback host
field.help: Optional IPv6 host route installed while unhealthy and removed on recovery.

field.label: IPv6 fallback gateway
field.help: IPv6 peer next hop for the fallback host route, normally on the dedicated data-plane transit.
